item.stem:
The diagram shows a Koch Snowflake at step $0$ (one equilateral triangle) and at step $1$ after the side-replacement rule. Rohan predicts step $2$ from step $1$.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Replace every current side of the step-$1$ boundary with the same bump-shaped structure.
options.B: Call the next figure an equilateral triangle and treat that starting label as step $2$.
options.C: Update only the original three sides from step $0$, leaving the new bump edges unchanged.
options.D: A more jagged snowflake boundary is what produces the choice to bump every current side.
